methods.label: Find the side from the common perimeter
methods.explanation:
The equal perimeters let us use the triangle's sides to find the square's perimeter:
\[
6.1+8.2+9.7=24\text{ cm}.
\]
A square has four equal sides, so each side is \(24\div4=6\) cm. Its area is therefore
\[
6\times6=\boxed{36}\text{ cm}^2,
\]
which is choice \(\text{C}\).
